items.quote: The homogeneity of the sample was tested by the scanning electron microscope JEOL JSM-6460 in the back-scattered electron mode, using the EDS analysis.

items.applies_to: samples A and B annealed at 300 and 400 °C
items.quote: The temperatures of relevant invariant reactions were determined by DTA measurements of samples A and B annealed at 300 and 400 °C. The same samples as for the SEM analysis were used for the DTA. Netzsch DTA 404 S/3 was used for the measurements. A sample mass of 0.2 to 0.3 g was sealed into quartz capsules under vacuum and used for the measurements with Au as reference material. The heating rate 2.0 °C min-1 was employed for calibration (reference metals: Sb, Sn, Zn) and also for the measurements. The nominal compositions of the samples can be found in Table 2 together with relevant DTA results. The temperatures of the invariant phase reactions were usually taken from the extrapolated peak-onset on heating. The accuracy of all given temperatures is ± 2 °C.

The samples were prepared using high purity Pd (99.95 %) and Zn (99.9999 %), all supplied by Alfa Aesar, Karlsruhe, Germany. The pure materials were sealed into quartz capsules under vacuum, melted in a furnace at 1100 °C for 170 h, and quenched into the water.
items.synthesis: sealed into quartz capsules under vacuum, melted in a furnace at 1100 °C for 170 h, and quenched into the water

items.label: "B" alloys
items.quote: The second alloy, with a composition of 18 at.% of Pd ("B" alloys), was chosen in the region of c-phase expected according to both papers[22-23] to find phase boundaries of this phase.
The pure materials were sealed into quartz capsules under vacuum, melted in a furnace at 1100 °C for 170 h, and quenched into the water.

The low Pd samples were annealed for approx. 600 h at temperatures 300 and 400 °C. The time of annealing was selected with respect to previous set of experiments, dealing with this system, where the existence of g-phase was found.[32] The samples were afterwards quenched into the water and structure was prepared by OP-S polishing.
